name: irctc-tatkal-layer
description: Tatkal Readiness & Transparency Layer for IRCTC

scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names vault,analytics,mock,dashboard "npm run dev:vault" "npm run dev:analytics" "npm run dev:mock" "npm run dev:dashboard"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:shared && npm run build:vault && npm run build:analytics && npm run build:extension && npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:mock
scripts.test:all: npm --workspace=shared test && npm --workspace=vault-service test && npm --workspace=analytics-service test && npm --workspace=extension test
